Let \(P{\left(x \right)}\) be a polynomial of degree \(14\)with complex coefficients, and let \(P'(x)\) be the derivative of \(P{\left(x \right)}\). We know that \(gcd (P(x),P'(x))\) is a polynomial of degree \(8\). What is the number of distinct roots of of \(P{\left(x \right)}\) ? (both real and complex roots)
